node.title: Perl Script to Run other Scripts with proper pauses?
node.author: adamZ88
node.doctext: Monks, I need to create a Perl script that will run scripts 1,2 and 3, but I cannot have it run 2 before 1 is done executing and 3 before 2. How can I achieve this. The script that will run the others is in the same directory as them
